# Comprehensive Requirements Quality Checklist: User Story Tracker and Dashboard

**Purpose**: Validate requirements completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability across Tracker and Dashboard behavior
**Created**: 2026-11-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are required and optional fields for every user-story lifecycle state explicitly identified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are search semantics, including matching scope and ranking, documented for story discovery? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are all supported filter combinations and their interaction with search specified consistently? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are empty, partial, and fully populated story-data requirements defined? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are creation, update, status-change, soft-delete, and audit ownership requirements complete for every story field? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002 and FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are all required Dashboard chart categories and their source measures documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are CSV field sets, column definitions, and PDF report sections explicitly enumerated? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are administrator capabilities for recovering soft-deleted stories defined in scope? [Gap, Spec §FR-008a]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 - Is the meaning of "in progress" and "completed" unambiguously mapped to the story status set? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the sprint completion formula, including empty-sprint behavior, stated with an objective denominator and numerator? [Measurability, Clarifications and Spec §FR-012a]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "module" defined sufficiently to distinguish it from application and feature for data modeling and filtering? [Ambiguity, Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are authorization distinctions among creator, delivery manager, and administrator explicitly defined by permission rather than informal role labels? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008b]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are valid ranges, precision, units, and requiredness rules for story points specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is priority vocabulary quantified so it has a consistent meaning across list views and Dashboard filters? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001 and FR-004]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are the exact criteria for "matching stories" in chart drill-down selections defined for each chart type? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK016 - Do status labels and status-history requirements agree across story management, Dashboard KPIs, and chart definitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005 and FR-011]
- [ ] CHK017 - Do linear transition requirements conflict with any sample, edge case, or closed/reopened workflow expectation? [Conflict, Clarifications and Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are active-story rules for KPI totals, charts, story lists, exports, and soft-deleted data consistent? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010 and FR-008a]
- [ ] CHK019 - Do filter requirements apply uniformly to KPIs, charts, drill-down results, and exports? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015 and FR-017]
- [ ] CHK020 - Do permission and audit requirements remain consistent for creation, update, status change, deletion, and export? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007 and FR-020]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK021 - Can the two-minute story creation and discovery criterion be objectively measured without implementation assumptions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the 95% representative search and filter success criterion defined with a named sample, denominator, and test environment? [Gap, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is the zero-discrepancy aggregate criterion tied to a complete and reproducible acceptance dataset? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are supported display widths and device categories fully defined for critical journeys? [Clarity, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are the five-second Tracker-unavailability threshold and retry requirement measurable across all Dashboard views? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 - Are data requirements defined for stories with no sprint, release, assignee, dependencies, or optional grouping values? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are failure requirements specified for invalid dates, unknown filters, duplicate IDs, and invalid status transitions? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are partial export, export cancellation, large-result, and retry requirements specified separately from normal export success? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are concurrent update, stale-view, and conflict-resolution requirements addressed for status and story mutations? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are audit requirements defined for failed mutations, denied actions, and export attempts as well as successful actions? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are retained status history and audit trail retention durations or lifecycle rules specified? [Gap, Assumptions]

## Security and Privacy Requirements

- [ ] CHK032 - Are authentication and authorization requirements stated for every read, mutation, audit, and export operation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are rules preventing direct Dashboard access to Tracker data stores explicit and objectively reviewable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are sensitive fields, audit visibility rules, and export data-protection requirements identified? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are authentication failure, expired access, and insufficient-permission requirements defined consistently? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK036 - Are secret-storage, logging-redaction, and client-bundle exposure requirements complete and measurable? [Completeness, Constitution §VII]

## Accessibility and Responsiveness

- [ ] CHK037 - Are keyboard, focus, semantic, label, and contrast requirements specified for chart and drill-down interactions? [Gap, Constitution §VI]
- [ ] CHK038 - Are empty, loading, error, and unavailable-data states specified for accessible operation across Dashboard views? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK039 - Are responsive layout requirements complete for the defined 320 px, 768 px, and 1440 px widths? [Completeness, Constitution §V]
- [ ] CHK040 - Are chart results required to have non-visual alternatives for users who cannot perceive graphical data? [Gap, Constitution §VI]

## Data, Integration, and Operational Quality

- [ ] CHK041 - Are dependencies between external identity, Tracker API, and PDF/CSV export capabilities explicitly documented? [Dependency, Plan]
- [ ] CHK042 - Are API versioning and backward-compatibility requirements defined for shared Dashboard/Tracker contracts? [Gap, Constitution Technology Constraints]
- [ ] CHK043 - Are Tracker availability, degradation, timeout, retry, and data-freshness requirements documented for dashboard reads? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK044 - Is the documented expected load sufficient to define the dashboard 500 ms p95 performance gate? [Ambiguity, Plan]
- [ ] CHK045 - Are transaction and rollback requirements defined for story updates that also create status-history or audit entries? [Gap, Constitution §IV]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK046 - Is the assumption that identity roles already exist supported by a documented provisioning boundary? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK047 - Is the assumption that metadata values may be selected or entered resolved for user and administrator behavior? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK048 - Are expected data volumes, concurrent users, and export limits quantified enough for capacity and pagination requirements? [Gap, Plan]
- [ ] CHK049 - Are the refresh and data-freshness assumptions explicitly bounded for normal navigation versus real-time updates? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
